result:
Phase 3 Chunk 2 complete. I implemented the `GET /profile` route and template per spec:

- **`api/profile.py`** (new): `handle_profile()` — session-scoped, no `?id=` parameter, sources data from `get_user_profile` (DB, not session copies), and fail-closes to `login` when `profile is None` (handles stale session A5).
- **`templates/profile.html`** (new): standalone (no `{% extends %}`), mirrors `account_detail.html`'s navbar/`banking.css` structure, references only `profile.username`, `profile.email`, `profile.full_name`, `profile.address` (no `id`/`created_at`).
- **`app.py`** (edit): one import alongside the other api imports, one `/profile` route placed after the `account` route; existing routes untouched, no nav link added.

Verification: the locked `test/test_profile_route.py` was not modified and all 6 tests pass (GREEN), and the full suite shows 96 passed with no regressions. The git diff confirms scope was limited to the three intended files.
